I built Copay Compass with Grok @bot for people stuck on the cost of a cancer drug.
-> It finds the help
-> It signs you up for the reopen alerts and preps the application.
-> It never asks for your SSN or MRN
-> It never gives medical advicehttps://t.co/KUmBcg9Dpe
